entries.title: Find a task moves the caret to the Tasks search from a card
entries.body: After you used the Tasks panel and then went straight to a field in a card, pressing ⇧⌘F (Ctrl+Shift+F on Linux) could open the Tasks search but leave the caret in the card, so your next keys landed there. The caret now moves to the Tasks search.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new is drawn: this fixes where the caret lands after a key, which a still picture cannot show.
